node.title: E1 folded no-vector certificate payload for N'=256
node.statement: Over the named E1 Pocklington field and displayed primitive 256th root, construct a complete machine-checkable folded-kernel certificate proving that no nonzero non-cyclotomic vector w in {-2,-1,0,1,2}^128 satisfies the N'=256 folded kernel equation.
node.attack_surface: actual complete no-vector certificate for the N'=256 folded kernel over the named field/root
node.falsifier: a nonzero non-cyclotomic folded vector in the named N'=256 field/root, or an incomplete certificate transcript
node.notes: FALSE-GREEN CORRECTION: the req edge into e1_folded_certificate_cell_256_payload consumes a complete zero-vector certificate. The banked bad-prime average is only an almost-all-primes survivor-density estimate and does not certify the named field, prove the required finite zero statement, or establish the family-uniform prize quantifier. The prior BKZ run was explicitly inconclusive. See status_ruling.md.
